# gronka name and brand

The code is MIT licensed (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)): run it, change it, host it for any number
of people, call your bot whatever you like. Nothing here limits that.

The gronka name, logo and penguin are trademarks of gronkanium, and the artwork is copyright
2025-2026 gronkanium, all rights reserved. The artwork in this repository is `web/public/p/`,
both favicons, `web/public/apple-touch-icon.png`, `web/public/og.png` and
`.github/assets/banner.png`.

- You can use the artwork, as it is or edited, in your own running copy of gronka.
- You can use the name and artwork to write about, review or link to gronka.
- Don't use the artwork in other projects or on things you sell.
- Don't present your copy as the official gronka (the one at gronka.dev), and don't release a fork
  or a different product under the gronka name.

Anything else, open an issue and ask.
